title: UI Interaction, Modal by @jeetnirnejak: Padlock: a suitcase combo lock, just on a screen. spin the three wheel
notes:
Padlock: a suitcase combo lock, just on a screen. spin the three wheels the same way you would on a bag. if you pause mid-flick and let go, leftover velocity used to keep the wheel spinning. now it only reads the last 100ms, so a dead stop lands on the digit you're holding.

Designer: @jeetnirnejak. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
